reason: Review 2 found that the near-equal accumulator-arm subset of addendum 1 (51 arms) contains 15 arms identical to their wide arm (binary discordance 0 at n = 1,000: control arms and event-free widths), which lowers the planning discordance for H3; that the knife-edge statement counted every interval with an end point at 0 as missing a negative truth; and that no summary row holds the recipe-pair equivalence image count. This addendum separates identical contrasts, gives per-contrast sufficiency shares, a full power grid, the end-point split of the knife-edge misses, and an exact-cell (enumerated) coverage for the low-discordance scenarios.

definitions.identical_contrast: a v1 subsample contrast whose lowest-index binary discordance at n = 1,000 is 0 (the two arms give the same lowest-index top-1 outcome on every image). Its expected-credit difference may still be nonzero through tie shares (reported). Labelled 'control' (accumulator arm named control), 'event_free_width' (other accumulator arm) or 'other'.
definitions.near_equal: |diff_expected_pp| < t at n = 1,000, t in {1, 2, 3} pp (t = 2 is the post hoc v1 selection, registered in addendum 1)

items.identical_contrasts: list of identical contrasts per kind with label, diff_expected_pp and width_expected_median_n1000.
items.subsets: per kind, per subset in {all, all_differing, near_equal_t (t = 1, 2, 3), near_equal_t_differing}: count; discordance 25th, 50th, 75th percentile (numpy default interpolation); median 1k half-width (width_expected_median_n1000 / 2); median width_expected_median_n{128,256,512,1000}; projected half-width at N = 4,000 and 9,000 = median 1k half-width x sqrt(1000/N) (projection only); MDD(n, median discordance) for n = 1,000, 4,000, 9,000.
items.power_grid: images for power 0.8, alpha 0.05, normal approximation (tools.analysis.quality_metrics_v1.resolution.images_needed) for hypothesis in {difference, equivalence, noninferiority, beyond_margin} x kind x subset in {all, all_differing, near_equal_2, near_equal_2_differing} x discordance quantile in {q25, median, q75} x margin in {1.0, 0.5, 0.25} pp.
items.sufficiency: per kind and subset in {near_equal_2, near_equal_2_differing, all_differing}: share of contrasts whose own discordance gives images_needed <= N for N in {1,000, 4,000, 9,000}, per hypothesis in {noninferiority, equivalence, difference} and margin in {1.0, 0.5} pp.
items.knife_edge_endpoints: scenario pd_q5_asym_q95 (v1 scenario index 4), identical v1 draws (default_rng([20261002, 21, 4, n])), n in {128, 256, 512, 1000}, per method: coverage of its own truth (must reproduce v1), share of intervals with lower end at 0 only, upper end at 0 only, both ends at 0; share missing the truth split into 'lower end at 0' and 'other'.
items.exact_cell_coverage: for every v1 scenario with discordance <= 0.05 (pd_q5_* five scenarios, null_pd1, null_pd2, null_pd5) and the addendum-1 symmetric null at discordance 0.0255, n in {128, 256, 512, 1000}: coverage = sum over discordant counts (left, right) of the multinomial probability times the indicator that the interval covers the truth, enumerated over all count pairs with probability mass captured >= 1 - 1e-6 (captured mass reported). Intervals: bootstrap seed 0 = the lane's resolution.intervals (identical to v1); seeds 1 and 2 = the same construction with default_rng([20261002, 20, n, left, right, seed]). Reported per seed and as the mean over the three seeds, with the v1 2,000-data-set value beside it.
items.single_values: McNemar p-values in the document are printed to two significant digits (no truncation).
